snippet.title: Merlok 2.0 Needs You! - LEGO NEXO KNIGHTS - How to Play
snippet.description: Merlok 2.0 is calling for your help and he has included instructions! Merlok explains how to quest like a knight, how to hunt for powers and upgrade your knights to new levels of monster-beating potential. So hear Merlok’s call and hurry on to become a Nexo Knight and join the fight against the evil Jestro and his armies of lava monsters.
